$comment: Golden fixtures for allocation. Every case asserts both the exact split and that the shares sum back to the total. Changing the residue rule — which part absorbs the odd unit, or the order ties break in — must fail a test here.

cases.name: the classic: 100.00 three ways
cases.why: 33.33 three times is 99.99. The lost paisa goes to the first part, and the sum is 100.00

cases.name: one paisa, three ways
cases.why: there is no fraction of a paisa to give the other two

cases.name: two paise, three ways
cases.why: the residue is handed out one unit at a time, not all to one part

cases.name: negative total, three ways
cases.why: a credit note splits the mirror image of the invoice. Truncation is towards zero, so the residue keeps the total's sign

cases.name: zero splits into zeros
cases.why: and no part receives a signed zero

cases.name: seven ways, six parts absorb the residue
cases.why: 1.428571... truncates to 1.42, leaving six paise to hand out

cases.name: half a paisa each, tie broken by position
cases.why: both parts are short by exactly half a unit; the earlier one wins

cases.name: lakh-scale, still exact
cases.why: magnitude does not change the argument

cases.name: weights 3:2:1
cases.why: the residue goes to the largest shortfall, which here is the smallest share

cases.name: weights 4:2:1 — the residue lands on the last part
cases.why: position does not decide it: 14.285714 is short by more than the other two, so it takes the paisa

cases.name: a zero weight receives nothing
cases.why: a zero weight is allowed; only an all-zero set is not

cases.name: fractional weights
cases.why: weights need not be whole, or sum to anything in particular

cases.name: weights that are themselves amounts
cases.why: the payment-allocation shape: settle a receipt across outstanding invoices

cases.name: a payment short of the invoices it settles
cases.why: part payment spread pro rata, to the paisa

cases.name: quantity scale
cases.why: the smallest unit follows the rounding point, so quantities split at 3dp

cases.name: whole units
cases.why: the same argument with a unit of 1

cases.name: the total is fixed at the rounding point first
cases.why: 100.005 is not representable at money scale; it becomes 100.01 and that is what the shares sum to

rejected.why: a negative weight would point a share away from the total
